assumptions.ordering: Ascending shard/group/file relative indexed paths; raw WalkDir is not sorted and does not independently guarantee this ordering. Binding the already accepted ordered base fixture signature pins the accepted sequence.
assumptions.base_fixture_provenance: The two base fixture signatures are adopted frozen G0 bindings supplied/confirmed by the parent, not derived anew by this identity-only script. Hash calculations above do not read baseline or measurement output.
assumptions.root: Same-host canonical Windows C: verbatim owned index root; no private absolute root is read or retained. Normalized full owned paths use @owned-index; filter kind drive-prefix normalizes to //?/c.
assumptions.presentation: Source action_fixture long period 19, UTF-8 labels/descriptions and original Option args retained.
assumptions.catalog: Half custom actions followed by half indexed actions. Custom zero takes indexed-zero ID; custom-zero description appends ; accepted external replacement. ID lookup retains the later indexed winner.
assumptions.results: Exactly accepted catalog index 9, with complete Action including args.
assumptions.completion: Both supported observed states are bound explicitly. Pending/unrebuilt suggestions are empty; rebuilt suggestions contain exactly app synthetic action 00009 — 東京. The 120ms production debounce is neither forced nor excluded. Collector must validate actual completion receipt and suggestions against the corresponding conditional ID.
assumptions.scope: Same accepted catalog/query projection for all three C3-C recipes; no measurement-dependent constants, app invocation, native operation, Cargo, or production-source changes.

framing.initialization: unframed UTF-8 domain bytes, then LE-u64 seed, then LE-u64 count
framing.strings: LE-u64 UTF-8 byte length followed by UTF-8 bytes
framing.options: LE-u64 0 for None; LE-u64 1 then framed string for Some

frozen_order_binding.qualification: Base fixture signature includes ordered initial/replacement/indexed Action identities; current companion strict signature pins that sequence. No traversal sorting change is introduced.
